u_scale_decision_da3.ratio_match: NOT reachable: a linear extrapolation of the weak P3 translation response (0.06 m/s per +0.15 u_scale) would need u_scale ~ 2.4 = 16x Astra's preset (0.48 units/latent) for ours' 0.96 m/s at 12 deg/s, far outside its training motion; Astra executes rotation and suppresses translation when both are commanded (P1 alone moves at 1.1 m/s).
u_scale_decision_da3.input_ratio_match: at u_scale 0.15 Astra's INPUT per latent is 0.22 m (7.3 m/unit x 0.03) per 2.4 deg = 0.092 m/deg vs ours' realised 0.080 (ratio-matched input u_scale 0.131; 0.20 with the drifted yaw gain 1.5) - 0.15 lies inside that band and inside DA3's +-15 % metric-scale spread
u_scale_decision_da3.why: Astra's own preset forward speed (its 'held W key', PROTOCOL §2 keyboard rule and rule 3: the baseline at its native operating point), equal to the input-ratio match within the measurement error; larger values do not buy translation on P3 and are outside the model's demo range; keeps the frozen P1/P3 clips valid. Override for experiments: run.sh U_SCALE=x / astra_gen.py --u-scale.
u_scale_decision_da3.consequence_for_metrics: Astra's RPE-Trans on P3/P4/P5 will reflect the dropped translation; P2/P3 RPE-Rot the 1.5x drifted pan; both are the model's behaviour at the protocol's rates (18 deg/s = 2.1x its preset), a slower P2' is the fair complement (PROTOCOL rule 2)

measurement_da3.method: baselines/astra/calib_da3.py: Depth Anything 3 (DA3NESTED-GIANT-LARGE-1.1, /home/hk28965/specwm/hf) on windows of 16 frames sampled every 2nd (one shared frame), nested model = metric (translations scaled by its per-window scale_factor, is_metric 1); per-step camera-frame motion with the converters' formulas (c2w = inv(w2c), yaw = atan2(Rr[0,2], Rr[2,2]), tr = R_i^T (t_{i+1}-t_i), forward = tr[2]); per 2.5 s segment and per window; cross-checks: phase-correlation shift and DIS optical flow (median horizontal px/frame for the pan at DA3's fx, radial divergence for forward).
